alt: An email exchange from April 27-28 details L.A. Care's counsel, Bill Seldeen, attempting to contact Nicolas Hernandez regarding his small claims filing, case L.A.S.C. 26AVSC00192 (LMR-8864), which Hernandez refuses, stating his position has not changed since March 26th and he will see them in court. Annotated by Nicolas Hernandez.
summary: This email exchange, occurring between April 27 and April 28, 2026, documents a direct communication from Bill Seldeen, Associate Legal Counsel for L.A. Care, regarding the litigation in Case 26AVSC00192. The record captures the health plan's attempt to initiate informal telephone discussions following the small claims filing, and the petitioner's subsequent refusal, maintaining a demand for all communications to be documented for court. Forensically, this record establishes the health plan's awareness of the pending legal action and the petitioner's strict adherence to formal procedural boundaries during the dispute resolution phase.
